canadian_mission.name: Embassy of Canada to the Netherlands

notes_for_senders.fact: PostNL: a letter or card abroad must carry international stamps (or a postzegelcode); maximum size 38 x 26.5 x 3.2 cm, minimum 14 x 9 cm, maximum weight 2 kg.
PostNL publishes 'from €2,11' as the starting price for a letter or card abroad; the exact price depends on weight and destination.

unverified_skipped: Price of a 20 g letter to Canada: PostNL page gives only 'from €2,11'; the 2026 tariff booklet PDF (tarievenboekje-12-juli-2026.pdf) could not be read as text, so no Canada/zone row verified.
Transit time to Canada: PostNL publishes only '2 à 3 werkdagen' for many European countries and 'Buiten Europa: 2-3 werkdagen' for business express; no consumer figure for Canada found.
VAC operator 'VFS Global' taken from the VAC website links (visa.vfsglobal.com/.../can) on the IRCC page; the IRCC page itself does not print the operator name.
